developments.summary: Family Bank admitted to the Main Investment Market Segment by introduction. Kenya Mortgage Refinance Company listed the second tranche of its KShs 3 billion Sustainability Bond. TRIFIC Green USD I-REIT listed as Kenya's first US dollar denominated green income REIT.
Launched its first real-time bond consolidated tape operated by ETS Connect UK, with 98 per cent market coverage, becoming the first country outside North America to implement one.
MAS introduced a framework for dual listings on SGX supporting the Global Listing Board, a joint SGX and Nasdaq initiative, streamlining cross-border IPOs with a single set of offering documents.
